summary: Refine RF config near the winner; keep if repeated CV improves
reasoning: Seed-0 CV is 0.8152 but the floor is 0.80, so I want a wider margin before the one held-out scoring. The screen showed max_features=1.0 with min_samples_leaf=3 best (0.8152/0.8030/0.8131 over seeds 0/1/2); refinement will search a tight grid around it (max_features 0.75-1.0, leaves 2-5, split 2-5, entropy) at 400 trees, then test the top 2 at 1000 trees over seeds 0,1,2. Adopt the new config only if its repeated mean beats the incumbent 0.8104; write the adopted config's seed-0 cv_auc to out/metrics.json (only). Expectation: near-boundary refinement on 1000 rows typically adds ~0.005-0.01; expect refined cv >= 0.81 and adopt only on improvement, so the conservative expectation is cv_auc >= 0.80 (floor) with exit_ok — the incumbent already stands at 0.8152 if nothing improves.
